title: Swinging fish-hook with float
section: Second round: Acts III and IV
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Widow's Bay.
A short length of fishing line from the top centre down to a red-and-cream cork float, then a big barbed steel hook below it, seen square-on, the hook opening to the left. Match lantern-hanging. Flat painted toy-theatre cut-out seen square-on, gouache on card with a faint pale cut edge; early-1900s stencil-tinted colour: sepia-grey line and tone with translucent washes of plum #2a1424, rose pink #f3c6dc, magenta #e0127a, moon gold #d9b34a, coral red #c8321e and grotto teal #5f8c88 laid slightly out of register; no cast shadow; no lettering; isolated on a transparent background (or flat pure magenta #FF00FF if transparency is unavailable).
Requested final aspect ratio 80:220. Real transparent alpha outside the isolated art.
Input image is a style/palette reference; follow the written subject and geometry rather than reproducing unwanted elements.
No text or watermark.
